scope: Research only for a local Docker static site service alongside GitHub Pages; no implementation, install, container start, login, or spend.

host_observation.actions: Version/state inspection only; no images pulled and no containers created or started.

options.name: nginx/nginx-unprivileged
options.reason: Maintained NGINX image variant defaults to an unprivileged user, port 8080, and writable PID/temp paths under /tmp, directly matching a static local server with read-only rootfs.
options.caveat: Recheck tag/digest at implementation and note target architecture; no image pull or digest verification through local daemon was performed.

options.name: Official nginx image
options.reason_not_selected: Default behavior is root-oriented; satisfying the same non-root/read-only/8080 contract requires more configuration and validation than the maintained unprivileged variant.

healthcheck.probe_dependency: Confirm wget exists in selected image during implementation; avoid adding a package solely for the probe unless evidence requires it.
healthcheck.restart_semantics: Healthcheck marks unhealthy but does not itself restart the container; restart policy reacts to process/container exit.

proposed_runtime.persistence: No volume: static content is built into image; Pages remains the canonical public HTTPS deployment.

proposed_validation: Verify runtime non-root, ReadonlyRootfs, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, and applied resource constraints
HTTP status and local content/hash checks for /, /healthz, data/knowledge.json, data/context.txt, and a static asset
Negative 404 route, browser interaction smoke check, and confirm only loopback host binding
Separate process restart from unhealthy-only behavior and document that healthcheck alone does not restart
Rollback by prior version-controlled commit and rebuild
